extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent practitioners, and applicants preparing biotechnology-related patent applications (including sequence and biological material disclosures)
extracted.subtask_description: MPEP Chapter 2400 guidance on handling biotechnology-specific patent issues, including deposit of biological material, sequence listing requirements (WIPO ST.26/ST.25), submission formats (XML/CRF), examination procedures, and related procedural requirements for U.S. patent practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Deposit Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing when and how biological materials should be deposited to satisfy patent disclosure requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deposit of Biological Material
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and considerations for depositing biological material that is part of a patent disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material Capable of Self-Replication
rubrics_metrics.description: Special considerations and requirements for deposits of materials capable of self-replication (e.g., microorganisms).

rubrics_metrics.name: Plant Material
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deposit and disclosure rules applicable to plant material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Need or Opportunity to Make a Deposit
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on when a deposit is necessary or advisable for meeting disclosure enablement/written description requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biological Material That Is Known and Readily Available to the Public
rubrics_metrics.description: Criterion addressing when deposited material that is already publicly known/available may negate the need for a deposit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biological Material That Can Be Made or Isolated Without Undue Experimentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Criterion treating material that can be obtained or isolated without undue experimentation and its impact on deposit necessity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference to a Deposit in the Specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and proper manner for referring to a deposited biological material within the patent specification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptable Depository
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for what depositories qualify as acceptable for receiving and storing deposited biological material for patent purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time of Making an Original Deposit
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on the timing of making an original deposit relative to filing dates and the consequences for patent rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description in Application Specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to include an adequate description in the specification concerning a deposited biological material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deposit After Filing Date - Corroboration
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and evidentiary considerations when a deposit is made after the application filing date and how to corroborate disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Possible Loss of U.S. Filing Date in Other Countries
rubrics_metrics.description: Warning that deposit timing may affect foreign priority or filing date recognition in other jurisdictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement or Supplement of Deposit
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and requirements for replacing or supplementing an earlier deposit of biological material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement or Supplement - In a Pending Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules specifically governing replacement or supplementation of deposits while the application is pending.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement or Supplement - After a Patent Has Issued
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on whether and how a deposit may be replaced or supplemented after grant of a patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Failure to Replace
rubrics_metrics.description: Consequences and procedural results if a required replacement of a deposit is not made.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of Replacement
rubrics_metrics.description: How replacement deposits are treated administratively and legally (e.g., effect on disclosure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exemption From Replacement
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances under which replacement of a deposit may be exempted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement May Not Be Recognized
rubrics_metrics.description: Situations where a replacement deposit might not be acknowledged for legal/priority purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Term of Deposit
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and expectations regarding how long a deposited biological material must be maintained by the depository.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viability of Deposit
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for the continued viability of deposited biological material and its relevance to sufficiency of disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Furnishing of Samples
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and requirements for furnishing samples of deposited material upon request (e.g., to the public or to the Patent Office).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditions of Deposit
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific conditions that must be met by deposits (storage, access conditions, confidentiality, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification of Statement of Availability of Deposit
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement for certification statements regarding availability of the deposited material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination Procedures for Deposit Issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural guidance for examiners on handling deposit-related issues during prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejections Based on Deposit Issue
rubrics_metrics.description: Grounds and practice for issuing examiner rejections where deposit-related deficiencies affect patentability or sufficiency of disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replies to Rejections Based on Deposit Issue
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for submitting responses to deposit-related rejections in prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application in Condition for Allowance Except for Deposit
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures when an application is otherwise allowable but for unresolved deposit matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of Application with Respect to Deposited Material
rubrics_metrics.description: What the application must contain concerning deposited materials (e.g., identifying information, accession numbers, statements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to Include a Sequence Listing in XML Format
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent applications containing nucleotide and/or amino acid sequence disclosures must include a sequence listing in the specified XML file format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of the Sequence Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: General explanatory material about sequence listing requirements and applicable standards (WIPO ST.26/ST.25 and 37 CFR provisions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'Sequence Listing XML'
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and scope of what constitutes a compliant 'Sequence Listing XML' file for sequence disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enumeration of Residues and Sequence Identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements regarding the enumeration of residues and use of unique sequence identifiers within the listing and cross-references in the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nucleotides and Amino Acids Included and Excluded From a 'Sequence Listing XML'
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules specifying which nucleotide/amino acid entities must be included or may be excluded from the sequence listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions: 'Specifically Defined', 'Amino Acid', 'Modified Amino Acid', 'Nucleotide', 'Modified Nucleotide'
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions used to interpret what sequence data and modifications must be represented in the sequence listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Sequence Identifiers to Denote Sequences Disclosed in the Description, Drawings or Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to use sequence identifiers consistently to reference sequences disclosed elsewhere in the application (description, drawings, claims).

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation and Symbols for Nucleotide and/or Amino Acid Sequences
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for how sequence data must be represented, including allowed symbols and conventions for nucleotides and amino acids.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Sequentially Numbered Sequence Identifiers in the 'Sequence Listing XML'
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that sequence identifiers in the XML be sequentially numbered to permit cross-referencing and clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation and Inclusion of Variants
rubrics_metrics.description: How to represent sequence variants in the listing and whether/how variants should be included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation of Special Situations
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on handling non-standard or special sequence-disclosure situations in the listing (edge cases).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement for Exclusive Conformance; Sequences Presented in Drawing Figures
rubrics_metrics.description: Mandate that sequence listings must exclusively conform to the required standard and rules for sequences shown in drawings versus the listing file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of Patent Applications Claiming Large Numbers of Nucleotide Sequences
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, considerations, and examiner practices for applications that disclose large numbers of sequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of a 'Sequence Listing XML' and Form and Format of the File
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed requirements concerning the parts and structure of the required XML sequence listing file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parts of the 'Sequence Listing XML' (UTF-8, DTD, XML/DOCTYPE/Root, General Info, Sequence Data, Language Values, Title)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific mandatory elements of the Sequence Listing XML file: single file encoded in Unicode UTF-8; valid according to the DTD; contains an XML declaration and a DOCTYPE declaration; contains a root element; contains a General Information part and a Sequence Data part; language-dependent free text qualifier values in English; title element, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form and Format of the XML File Containing the 'Sequence Listing XML'
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical format requirements for the XML file (encoding, structure, compliance with DTD/schema).

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Submit the 'Sequence Listing XML'
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for submitting the sequence listing XML to the Office (electronic filing requirements and methods).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements Regarding Incorporation By Reference of the 'Sequence Listing XML'
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on whether and how a sequence listing XML can be incorporated by reference into the specification and related formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presumptions Regarding Compliance with Sequence Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural presumptions the Office will make about compliance/noncompliance with sequence listing requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of a Failure to Comply with Sequence Listing Requirements (37 CFR 1.835)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for issuance of notices and the applicant's options when the sequence listing requirements are not met under 37 CFR 1.835.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment to Add an Initial 'Sequence Listing XML' under 37 CFR 1.835(a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for amending an application to add an initial sequence listing XML when omitted originally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Adding to, Deleting from, or Replacing Sequence Information in a 'Sequence Listing XML' under 37 CFR 1.835(b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and limits for amending, deleting, or replacing sequence information in the XML listing under the cited rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation of 'Sequence Listing XML' Is Not an Amended 'Sequence Listing XML'
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarification that translating the XML into another language does not constitute an amendment under the cited provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notifications for Failure to Submit a 'Sequence Listing XML' in an International Application to be Searched/Examined by US ISA/IPEA
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and notifications relevant when an international (PCT) application fails to include the required XML listing when the US ISA/IPEA is involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment of a 'Sequence Listing XML' in a Patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how and when a sequence listing XML may be amended after patent grant (if applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability Date of 'Sequence Listing XML' Requirements and Procedures for Failure to Submit Correct Format
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules determining when the XML requirements apply based on filing date and the procedures for handling incorrect format submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determining if a 'Sequence Listing XML' Must Be Submitted
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for deciding whether a particular application filing requires submission of a Sequence Listing XML.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisional Applications Containing Disclosures of Nucleotides/Amino Acids - Compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for compliance with sequence listing requirements in provisional applications (37 CFR 1.831-1.834).

rubrics_metrics.name: Improper Submissions of 'Sequence Listing' under 1.821(c) When an XML Was Required
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and consequences for submitting non-XML sequence listings when XML was mandated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form Paragraphs and Sample Statements for Sequence Rules Compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Model form paragraphs and sample statements applicants may use to comply with sequence listing and deposit-related requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Helpful Hints and Tools for Sequence Rules Compliance (WIPO ST.26 and WIPO Sequence Tool)
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical hints and references to tools (e.g., WIPO Sequence Tool) to assist applicants in complying with sequence listing requirements (ST.26 guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishing Patent Grants and Application Publications with a 'Sequence Listing XML'
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and formats for publishing patents and application publications that include a sequence listing XML, including handling of non-lengthy, lengthy, or very large listings (e.g., >=1GB).

rubrics_metrics.name: WIPO ST.25 Sequence Rules (Legacy) - Requirements and Applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for sequence listings under WIPO ST.25 where applicable, including definitions of sequence listing and computer readable form (CRF), format/symbol rules, and transition matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format and Symbols To Be Used for Sequence Data under WIPO ST.25
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific symbol/format conventions required for ASCII plain text sequence listings under the legacy WIPO ST.25 standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form and Format for a Nucleotide/Amino Acid Sequence Submission as an ASCII Plain Text File (WIPO ST.25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed form/format requirements for submitting sequence listings as ASCII plain text files under WIPO ST.25.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments to Add or Replace a 'Sequence Listing' and CRF Copy Thereof Subject to WIPO ST.25
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for amending or replacing a sequence listing and the required computer readable form copy under ST.25 rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sample 'Sequence Listing' and Sample Statements under WIPO ST.25
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability of sample listings and statements to assist compliance with ST.25 requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Box Sequence; Hand Delivery of a 'Sequence Listing' and Computer Readable Forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for physical delivery/hand delivery of sequence listings and CRF media (e.g., box sequence submission practices).

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of Patent Applications Claiming Large Numbers of Nucleotide Sequences (Repeated/Expanded)
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical examiner guidance on searching/examining applications that disclose very large numbers of sequences, including workload/format considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishing of Patents and Application Publications with a Lengthy 'Sequence Listing'
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how the Office publishes patents/application publications when the sequence listing is lengthy, including special publication formatting or storage considerations.
